description: The European Central Bank's euro foreign exchange reference rate in force on a day: units of the currency per 1 EUR, as the exact value the ECB published (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD), with fixing_date, the date of the fixing it is. The ECB fixes rates on TARGET working days around 16:00 CET; a weekend, a TARGET holiday, or today before 16:00 CET takes the last working day's fixing, so the answer always says which one it used. Covers every day since 1999-01-04, including currencies the ECB has since dropped (HRK, RUB, BGN, ...) on the days it published them.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, ...; EUR where the tool allows it; case ignored.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD in Frankfurt; default today.

name: rate

fixing_date.description: The date of the ECB fixing this rate is

rate.description: The ECB's exact value, units of the currency per 1 EUR

title: ECB rate on a day
